mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month indicates a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points, signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals robust consumer demand, which is a strong indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative over the previous quarter, it signals an accommodative monetary policy in a recessionary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate policy-driven recovery.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1% and GDPC1 shows negative growth.
